title: Red Rocks
wikitext:
[[Image:Red_Rocks.jpg|thumb|The sacred Red Rocks.]]

The '''Red Rocks''' are located in the northeastern area of [[Mulgore]]. They are ancient ancestral holy grounds for the [[tauren]] [[tribe]]s because they hold a great spiritual energy potential. Recently, a group of [[quilboar]]s had invaded the Red Rocks and defiled the holy place with their filth, which has greatly enraged the tauren of [[Thunder Bluff]].
